assumptions: Pinned headless V2, four switches OFF, no StallWatchdog or external interventions.
proof: Every movement alternative requires at least one stationary member to release a node or stable merge admission first. Mutable/idle vehicles include every outgoing edge. Thus no member can be first to move under the modelled transitions.
